note: Alberta Parks recreation area on Waterton Reservoir, about 25 km south then east of Pincher Creek: open prairie sites with a boat launch and pier. No firewood is sold. The hand pump's water is not safe to drink or use; bring water. --Claude
summary: Read the Alberta Parks page (updated Aug 7, 2026), shop and closure map: C$21 unserviced confirmed; site count 25 -> 16 (10 reservable + 6 FCFS); booking corrected from FCFS-only to reservable with some FCFS; season May 8 - Sep 30 (was approximate May 1 - Oct 15); max 70 ft; NEW STATUS temporarily closed for redevelopment Nov 2026 - late June 2027 (shop: closed through Jun 28 2027); phone 403-394-0150 found. Lakefront looks too high: recommend lakeview.
flags: STATUS: construction closure advisory effective Nov 5, 2026 ('campground redevelopment project ... from November 2026 through June 2027 ... campground expansion and upgrades'; 'expected to reopen in late June 2027'). Written as temporarily_closed, reopens late June 2027. The closure map's notes say 'closed to public October 2026 to June 2027'. The layout (and site count) may change with the expansion.

PHONE (stored empty): recommend 403-394-0150 (page 'Information: 403-394-0150'). No Facility Operator line. Seniors line PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.'). WEBSITES: both stored URLs answered 200 and are this campground.

WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - recommend lakeview): the page sells 'waterfront sites' with 'Open views', but the shop tags only ONE of 16 sites 'Near Water' (site 07). On imagery the campground is a set of gravel spurs off a loop on open grass north of the reservoir; the south loop sits behind the swim beach/pier day use and the boat-launch road, ~30-60 m from the waterline at the imaged level, and the west spurs are ~60-90 m across open grass from the reservoir's west inlet. Reservoir drawdown moves the shoreline. The campground's own loop road and the day-use beach/launch lie between most sites and the water (on-water ruled out except possibly site 07, which can't be placed on imagery). Open ground all round, so a view is clear: lakeview.

NEIGHBOUR: the closure map labels the field of trailers immediately NW of the PRA (outside the construction polygon) 'CAMPGROUND CLOSED TO PUBLIC' - a separate non-public camp, not part of this entry.
PIN (49.33080,-113.68520): on the west spurs of the PRA campground; page directions point 49.330188,-113.684476 (~70 m). OK.
2027: the shop shows 'Closed through Mon Jun 28 2027' (construction), so the 2027 season will start late.
